tags.name: chernoff-face
tags.description: A face whose features show data: each is a number from 0 to 1.

attributes.name: face-width
attributes.description: 0 narrow … 1 wide. Default 0.5, like every feature.

attributes.name: eye-size
attributes.description: 0 small … 1 large eyes.

attributes.name: eye-spacing
attributes.description: 0 close … 1 far-apart eyes.

attributes.name: pupil-size
attributes.description: 0 small … 1 large pupils.

attributes.name: gaze
attributes.description: 0 looking left … 1 looking right.

attributes.name: brow-slant
attributes.description: 0 angry … 1 worried brows.

attributes.name: nose-length
attributes.description: 0 short … 1 long nose.

attributes.name: mouth-width
attributes.description: 0 narrow … 1 wide mouth.

attributes.name: smile
attributes.description: 0 frown … 1 smile.

attributes.name: mouth-open
attributes.description: 0 closed … 1 open mouth.

tags.name: data-plot
tags.description:
A plot's frame: data, scales, and the layers drawn in it.

Events: `render`, `error`

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: `#id` of a `<table>`, `<datalist>`, or `<script type="application/json">` in the page. Default: one inside the plot.

attributes.name: x-domain
attributes.description: The x scale's ends, like `0 100` (`auto` keeps one end automatic). Numbers only.

attributes.name: y-domain
attributes.description: The y scale's ends, like `0 auto`.

attributes.name: x-padding
attributes.description: On a banded x scale, the share of each band left empty, 0–1. Default 0.2.

attributes.name: y-padding
attributes.description: The same for a banded y scale.

attributes.name: column-field
attributes.description: With `value-field`, reads a grid table (a row per item, a column per category): its column headers become this field.

attributes.name: value-field
attributes.description: With `column-field`: the field each cell's value becomes.

tags.name: plot-axis
tags.description: Tick labels and gridlines for one of the plot's scales.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.description: Which scale. Default `x`.

attributes.name: ticks
attributes.description: About how many ticks, on a numeric scale. Default (0): 6 for x, 5 for y.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: A title for the axis.

attributes.name: grid
attributes.description: Draw gridlines at the ticks.

tags.name: plot-legend
tags.description: A key to the plot's colors.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: A title for the legend.

tags.name: plot-line
tags.description:
A line through the rows, one per series.

Events: `render`, `error`

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: Field for horizontal position.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Field for vertical position.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Field that splits the rows into series, each its own color.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: `#id` of a `<table>`, `<datalist>`, or JSON `<script>` with this layer's own rows. Default: one inside it, else its plot's rows.

attributes.name: column-field
attributes.description: Reads a grid table, as on `<data-plot>`.

attributes.name: value-field
attributes.description: See `column-field`.

tags.name: plot-marks
tags.description:
One element per row, from a template, placed with CSS custom properties.

Events: `render`, `error`

attributes.name: x
attributes.description: Field for horizontal position. Sets `--x` (0 left … 1 right) and, on a banded scale, `--bandwidth`.

attributes.name: y
attributes.description: Field for vertical position. Sets `--y` (0 bottom … 1 top) and `--bandheight`.

attributes.name: x2
attributes.description: Field for the other end of a horizontal range, on x's scale. Sets `--x2`, and `--x-start`/`--x-length` (the range's left end and width), which the default CSS uses to stretch the mark.

attributes.name: y2
attributes.description: Field for the other end of a vertical range. Sets `--y2`, `--y-start`, and `--y-length`.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Field for color. Sets `--color`.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Field for size. Sets `--size` (0 … 1).

attributes.name: key
attributes.description: Field that identifies a row across updates. Default: its position.

attributes.name: repeat
attributes.description: Field with a count: the row is stamped that many times (a unit or waffle chart). Each copy gets `--index` and `--count`.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: `#id` of a `<table>`, `<datalist>`, or JSON `<script>` with this layer's own rows. Default: one inside it, else its plot's rows.

attributes.name: column-field
attributes.description: Reads a grid table, as on `<data-plot>`.

attributes.name: value-field
attributes.description: See `column-field`.
